original.statement: A new CAInjectorMerging feature gate is added to the ca-injector; when enabled, the injector merges new CA certificates instead of replacing the existing one.

decision.reason: [ev-e3729e495e40] says cert-manager 1.17.0 adds a `CAInjectorMerging` feature gate to the ca-injector. That supports a feature-gate subject named CAInjectorMerging, with the component spelled "ca-injector" as in the text, and a change type of added. The validator results were inconclusive because the chart could not be fetched, so they neither confirm nor refute the assertion.
